settings.title: We do the hardest part of selling: the first meeting.

settings.editor: Kadvia is an outbound and appointment-setting company from Delhi NCR, India. We help B2B teams reach the right decision-makers and turn cold contacts into booked meetings.

Good sales teams lose most of their week to research, follow-ups and messages that never get a reply. The part where their skill matters most, the actual sales conversation, gets the least time.

Kadvia flips that. We take over prospecting from the first touch to the booked meeting, so your people spend their time where they are best: in front of buyers.
We contact fewer, better-fit people. A short list of the right buyers beats a long list of strangers.
A real person writes, reads and answers every conversation. Buyers can tell the difference.
A weekly report shows exactly who we reached, who replied and what was booked. Nothing hidden.

A B2B sales professional who knows the front line of selling, from the first cold call to the signed deal. Divyansh started Kadvia to give growing companies a reliable way to reach the people who decide.
